.github/workflows/native-live.yml:
jobs:
  authz:
    name: authz
  native-live:
    name: native-live (${{ matrix.profile }})
    needs: [authz]
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - profile: live-sanitizers
            build_dir: build-live-sanitizers
            runner: gke-16cpu-32gb-amd64-256gb
          - profile: live-tsan
            build_dir: build-live-tsan
            runner: gke-16cpu-32gb-amd64-128gb
  native-live-shards:
    name: native-live-shard (${{ matrix.profile }}, ${{ matrix.shard }}/4)
    needs: [authz]
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        shard: [1, 2, 3, 4]
        include:
          - profile: native
            build_dir: build-live
  native-live-native:
    name: native-live (native)
    needs: [authz, native-live-shards]
  native-live-gate:
    needs: [authz, native-live, native-live-native]
.github/workflows/corpus-parity.yml:
jobs:
  authz:
    name: authz
  corpus-parity:
    needs: [authz]
  corpus-parity-subset:
    needs: [authz]
